commands.name: newdocument
commands.purpose: Create and open a new problem document.

parameters.name: doctype
parameters.description: Problem family selector.

notes: The cited definition does not specify a return value; do not rely on one.

effects: A new preprocessor document becomes available.
notes: Document types: 0 magnetics, 1 electrostatics, 2 heat flow, 3 current flow. Availability in a particular solver build is not execution-tested here.
The manual also names create(doctype); the Lua binding forwards newdocument to create.

commands.name: mi_probdef
commands.purpose: Configure magnetic problem frequency, length units, coordinate type and solver precision.
commands.signature: mi_probdef(frequency, units, type, precision, depth, minangle, acsolver)

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.description: Excitation frequency; zero denotes a static problem.

parameters.name: units
parameters.description: Length-unit name for the model.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Planar or axisymmetric model.

parameters.name: precision
parameters.description: Requested solver residual tolerance.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Into-page model depth for a planar problem.

parameters.name: minangle
parameters.description: Mesher minimum-angle constraint.

parameters.name: acsolver
parameters.description: AC solver selector; numeric encoding is not given in this command definition.

notes: The cited definition does not specify a return value; do not rely on one.

preconditions: A magnetics preprocessor document is active, for example after newdocument(0).
effects: Updates the magnetic problem definition.

requires: A magnetics preprocessor document is active, for example after newdocument(0).

notes: The signature is normalized: the printed manual omits its final outer closing parenthesis and uses parentheses to mark optional arguments.
Defaults for depth, minangle and acsolver are not stated in the cited command definition.
The printed units list has a missing quotation mark around meters; the value is stored without that typographical error.

commands.name: mi_addarc
commands.purpose: Draw a circular arc between existing geometry nodes near two endpoints.

parameters.name: x1
parameters.description: First coordinate; x for planar geometry or radial coordinate for axisymmetric geometry.

parameters.description: Second coordinate; y for planar geometry or axial coordinate for axisymmetric geometry.

parameters.description: Second coordinate; y for planar geometry or axial coordinate for axisymmetric geometry.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: Arc sweep angle.

parameters.name: maxseg
parameters.description: Maximum angular span per arc mesh element, stored in MaxSideLength; not a segment count.

notes: The cited definition does not specify a return value; do not rely on one.

preconditions: A magnetics preprocessor document is active, for example after newdocument(0).
The intended endpoint nodes already exist.

notes: The manual phrase divided into maxseg segments conflicts with the implementation.
The C++ adder stores maxseg in FArcSegment.MaxSideLength. The arc property setter writes the same field, whose documented unit is degrees per mesh element.
This interpretation is based on the pinned implementation, with container-specific geometry checks supplied separately.

commands.name: mo_getpointvalues
commands.purpose: Read magnetic field, potential, material and loss quantities at a point in a loaded solution.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: First coordinate; x for planar geometry or radial coordinate for axisymmetric geometry.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Second coordinate; y for planar geometry or axial coordinate for axisymmetric geometry.

values.name: A
values.description: Vector potential in planar problems, or flux in axisymmetric problems.

values.name: B1
values.description: x component of flux density, or radial component if axisymmetric.

values.name: B2
values.description: y component of flux density, or axial component if axisymmetric.

values.name: H1
values.description: x component of field intensity, or radial component if axisymmetric.

values.name: H2
values.description: y component of field intensity, or axial component if axisymmetric.

notes: Coordinate names follow the problem type: x/y for planar and r/z for axisymmetric.

preconditions: A magnetic solution is loaded, for example using mi_loadsolution().
The queried point lies in the solved model.
effects: Returns point quantities; does not construct geometry.

examples.code: A, B1, B2, Sig, E, H1, H2, Je, Js, Mu1, Mu2, Pe, Ph, ff = mo_getpointvalues(1, 0)
requires: A magnetic solution is loaded, for example using mi_loadsolution().
The queried point lies in the solved model.

notes: The ordered 14-value return table continues from PDF page 108 onto page 109.
The Lua binding expands result arrays into multiple return values and supports CComplex numbers. Imaginary parts are zero for magnetostatic problems.
Units for dimensional returned quantities are not stated in this command table and remain null here rather than being guessed.
